sections.heading: MAJOR IN POLITICAL SCIENCE
lines: Faculty of Social Science - Political Science

Completion of first-year requirements, including Political Science 1020E or both Political Science 1021F/G and Political Science 1022F/G or both Political Science 1025F/G and Political Science 1026F/G, with a mark of at least 60%.
0.5 course from: Political Science 2325F/G, Political Science 2350A/B, or acceptable substitute (must be pre-approved by the Department through Special Permission).
2.0 additional Political Science courses at the 2200 level or above.
1.5 additional Political Science designated essay courses (E, F or G) at the 3000 level.

Note: Students registered in a Major in Political Science may register in 2100-level Political Science courses. These courses may only be used as electives and cannot be counted towards the Major in Political Science modular requirements.
